title.value: Exploring the roles of artificial intelligence in surgical education: A scoping review
title.justification: The title directly indicates the paper is about AI in surgical education.
title.quote: Exploring the roles of artificial intelligence in surgical education: A scoping review

extractions.description: This paper reviews the application of artificial intelligence in surgical education, identifying current roles and future directions for AI-enhanced training. It covers the use of AI in skills assessment, training simulations, and feedback in the education of surgical trainees.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is focused on the role of AI in surgical education, rather than on sustainable development topics such as climate or ecological impacts.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The purpose of this scoping review is to explore the current and future roles of AI in surgical education.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not center around climate or ecological sustainable development themes, but rather on medical education and AI.
primary_category.quote: AI can help optimize the education of trainees and our results can help educators and researchers identify areas that need further investigation.

primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-categories listed pertain to climate and ecological impacts, which are not addressed in this paper focusing on surgery education and AI.
primary_sub_category.quote: Results: Out of 14,008 unique sources of evidence, 93 were included. Out of 93, 84 were conducted in the simulation setting, and 89 targeted technical skills.

new_primary_category.justification: The content of the paper is not related to any climate or ecological sustainable development categories.
new_primary_category.quote: Hence, the purpose of this scoping review is to explore the current and future roles of AI in surgical education.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's focus on surgical education and AI does not fit within predefined climate or ecological sub-categories.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Fifty-six studies focused on skills assessment/classification, and 36 used multiple AI techniques.
